collection-hearing-01.title: Making room for a question
collection-hearing-01.alt: An adult learner raises a hand beside an open notebook while the standing teacher looks toward him.
collection-hearing-01.caption: A raised hand interrupts the rush toward an easy answer. This imagined learning scene connects the sower's teaching about hearing and understanding with a practical habit: making room for a question. Listening can include admitting what we have not yet understood.

collection-hearing-02.title: Giving attention
collection-hearing-02.alt: A woman looks toward a young person explaining a small bridge model, with her hand resting on a phone on the counter.
collection-hearing-02.caption: The conversation receives attention while the phone rests on the counter. This imagined scene offers an everyday reflection on Jesus' invitation to take care how we hear. Giving another person room to explain can help us receive what a distracted glance might miss.
